SCAN l USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_library_1
LIST SUBQUERY 4
  SCAN json_each VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 1:
  CREATE BLOOM FILTER

SEARCH w USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_work_1 (id=?) LEFT-JOIN

  SEARCH vl USING COVERING INDEX work_library_work (work_id=?)
  LIST SUBQUERY 1
    SCAN json_each VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 1:
    CREATE BLOOM FILTER
  CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
